description:
Submit a document to HandInLoop for extraction with human-in-the-loop validation.

AI reads the document and scores every field for confidence first; low-confidence fields are reviewed and corrected by your own team, in a review screen built for it, before delivery. Every decision is signed and recorded. The result is validated data with per-field confidence and a complete audit trail.

ASYNC: returns immediately with a job_id and status 'queued'. Human turnaround is minutes to hours in production — poll handinloop_get_job_status (respect estimated_seconds_remaining), then call handinloop_get_job_result once status is 'completed'. Ideal for scheduled/recurring workflows.

VERIFIED-ANSWER LOOP (trust contract): declare your bar with 'verify' and hand off with 'callback_url'.
  - verify.critical_fields: names that MUST be human-verified before you get them back — a critical field the AI returns unverified (or omits) always goes to a human, even at confidence 1.0. Use this for anything you must not act on unchecked (e.g. "total", "bank_account").
  - verify.min_confidence (0..1): a stricter per-job bar; any field below it is routed to a human.
  - callback_url: an https endpoint HandInLoop POSTs the finished result to (with the signed proof embedded), so you can submit and walk away instead of polling. Verify the POST offline via the proof's signature against GET /v1/proof/public-key. Delivery status shows on handinloop_get_job_status under 'callback'.

Args:
  - task_type: one of the ids from handinloop_list_task_types (e.g. "invoice"), OR
  - fields: for CUSTOM extraction, describe the fields to extract yourself — [{ name, description? }]. Works on ANY document, not just the built-in task types. Provide task_type OR fields.
  - document_url OR document_base64: the document (PDF/image). Exactly one required.
  - file_name (optional): original filename for routing and audit
  - instructions (optional): note for the human reviewer
  - verify (optional): { critical_fields?: string[], min_confidence?: number } — your trust bar.
  - callback_url (optional): https endpoint for the result + proof (submit and walk away).
  - expected (optional): freight-invoice audit — { field: agreed_value } (e.g. { ocean_freight: 1800 }); mismatches come back as 'discrepancies' (overcharge/undercharge/mismatch/missing), human-verified.
  - tolerances (optional): per-field slack for the audit — { field: amount_or_percent } (e.g. { ocean_freight: '50', documentation_fee: '5%' }); a numeric expected field with no entry uses the default money tolerance.

Returns: { job_id, task_type, status, submitted_at, estimated_seconds_remaining }

callback_url.description: https endpoint the result + signed proof is POSTed to on completion (submit and walk away)

document_url.description: Publicly fetchable URL of the document (PDF or image)

expected.description: Freight-invoice audit (#157): your agreed values keyed by field name (e.g. { ocean_freight: 1800, container_count: 5 }). Extracted fields that don't match are flagged as discrepancies (overcharge/undercharge/mismatch/missing) and human-verified before return.

fields.description: Custom extraction: define the fields to extract instead of a built-in task_type. Provide task_type OR fields.

description.description: What this field is, to guide extraction, e.g. 'Delivery order number'

name.description: Field name to extract, e.g. 'do_number' (letters, digits, spaces, _ or -)

instructions.description: Free-form note passed to the human reviewer

task_type.description: Built-in task type id from handinloop_list_task_types, e.g. 'invoice'. Provide this OR fields.

tolerances.description: Freight-invoice audit per-field tolerance (#157): allowed slack keyed by field name, an absolute amount ('50') or a percentage of the expected value ('5%') — e.g. { ocean_freight: '50', documentation_fee: '5%' }. Each key must name a numeric expected field; a numeric field with no entry uses the default money tolerance.

verify.description: Verified-Answer Loop trust gate (#155): forces human review, never skips it

critical_fields.description: Field names that must be human-verified before the result is returned

min_confidence.description: Stricter per-job confidence floor; a field below it goes to a human

name: handinloop_submit_extraction_job
title: Submit Extraction Job
